name: DCA Shawarma Palace Morning Egg, Cheddar, Bacon & Potato Breakfast Wrap (Skip Spicy Harissa!)
brandOrRestaurant: Shawarma Palace (Avengers Campus · Disney California Adventure)
whyItWorks: Fluffy scrambled eggs, melted aged cheddar, crispy potato bites, and breakfast sausage/bacon wrapped in a warm pita—and because the fiery harissa sauce comes in a separate cup on the side, the wrap itself is completely mild!
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Breakfast Shawarma Wrap and **throw away or give away the side cup of spicy red Harissa sauce**.
watchOuts: NEVER pour the included side cup of red Harissa chili sauce onto the wrap
